name: Shelley
source: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Water Survey of Canada (HYDAT + real-time)
license: Open Government Licence - Canada. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada (Environment and Climate Change Canada).
notes: Upper Fraser above Prince George; no dam on the Fraser main stem upstream.

Archived daily means (HYDAT): 2011-01-01 to 2025-10-01. Rows with no water level (discharge only or blank): 22523. Level symbols: {'none': 4915, 'Partial Day': 140}. Estimated (E) -> estimated. Ice (B), partial day (A) and other symbols keep 'measured' but are counted here; ice can raise winter levels.
Datum check: on 201 days found in both HYDAT and the real-time record, our daily mean of the 5-minute readings minus the HYDAT daily mean was median +0.000 m (range -0.007 to +0.001).

After HYDAT ends: 5-minute real-time readings (2025-03-15 to 2026-10-15 UTC; rows by source {'wateroffice': 166664}) averaged into 378 daily means by local standard time day. A day counts only with readings in at least 20 of its 24 hours; 1 days left out. Approval of the readings: {'Provisional/Provisoire': 108864, 'Final/Finales': 57800}. A day whose readings are all 'Final' is 'measured', otherwise 'provisional'. Symbols: {'none': 166664}.
Station: FRASER RIVER AT SHELLEY, status Active, vertical datum field: ASSUMED DATUM.
Levels rounded to 0.001 m (the published precision); the API returns float noise such as 2.318000078201294.

measurement_history.fact: Water Survey of Canada flow record starts 1950: manual in 1950, recorder from 1951.
HYDAT has daily water levels for Shelley only from 2011 onward; earlier years publish flow only.
Levels use an assumed (local) datum; add 566.827 m for Geodetic Survey of Canada datum or 567.322 m for CGVD2013.
Station listed as not regulated, with a 32,430 square km drainage area.
Water level not available Jan. 18 to 23, 2024, because of equipment malfunction.
Gauge relocations or datum changes: not found in HYDAT tables or Water Survey of Canada station metadata.

public_notes: Water Survey of Canada publishes daily water levels at Shelley only from 2011; the longer record back to 1950 is river flow, not level. Levels are measured from a local gauge zero (an assumed reference), not from sea level.
